sermon.title: Jesus, the Greatest Gift
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that Jesus is the greatest gift—God our exceeding great reward—given out of love. Two things are required after believing: worship and obedience. From the woman who loved much, the leper, the ruler, the woman of Canaan and the women at the tomb, he shows that worship brings Jesus’ touch, and keeping his word brings the Father and Son to abide with us.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: he says “my faith” is not in the Bible (the phrase appears, e.g., James 2:18); Muslims bowing “three times a day to the east” (five daily prayers toward Mecca); Jesus never touched a demon-possessed person except the woman bent over (doctrinal claim); women at the tomb said to come to anoint (that detail is Mark 16:1). Sensitive content kept as spoken: Trump, Kasich, Cruz, Hillary Clinton and Bernie named; Pentecostal theatrics, prosperity preachers, Catholic/Baptist/Presbyterian remark; 1 Corinthians 11 hair and dress.

chunks.section_question: What did the leper and the ruler do?
chunks.short_answer: Matthew 8:2: a leper worshiped, saying Lord, if you will you can make me clean; Jesus touched him and he was cleansed immediately. Matthew 9:18: a ruler—a man of authority—worshiped and asked Jesus to touch his dead daughter, and she lived.

Then she came and worshiped Him, saying, “Lord, help me!”

faqs.question: Is Jesus greater than spiritual gifts?
faqs.answer: Yes—without Jesus none of those gifts can develop.

faqs.question: Is the Bible a book of faith?
faqs.answer: He says it is a book of truth that persuades and convinces us.

faqs.question: What will change America?
faqs.answer: The Lord Jesus Christ and the word of God, not a political party.

faqs.question: Does God hear a sinner?
faqs.answer: He hears a sinner who confesses and admits he needs God.

faqs.question: What is the main expression of worship?
Did the woman have to give money to be forgiven?
Does the Spirit convict women about hair?
faqs.answer: He says no—the Spirit convicts about the Ten Commandments.

faqs.question: Does screaming louder make God act?
faqs.answer: No—if something isn’t working, change the approach; she worshiped.

faqs.question: How do we overcome the wicked one?
faqs.answer: By the blood of the Lamb and the word of God.

faqs.question: Will Jesus meet those who seek him?
faqs.answer: Yes—when you seek him he will meet you.
